Title: Block resolution and continue as unblocked (Form of mist vs cats guidance)

Messages.Author: Nac
Messages.Body:
Hi

I couldn't find how to solve Form of Mist vs Cats Guidance so I ask on broader terms: What happens on block resolution of a "continue as unblocked" action. Does window still exists?

Many thanks on advance

Form of Mist

Protean Strike: dodge.
Superior Protean Strike: combat ends. After combat ends, if this vampire was blocked while performing an action, they can burn 1 blood to continue the action with +1 stealth as if unblocked, even if stealth is not yet needed. A vampire can play only one Form of Mist at superior each action.

Cats' Guidance

Animalism Only usable by a locked vampire who has blocked, after block resolution. Unlock this vampire.
Superior Animalism +1 intercept.

Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body: yes, you can use Cat's guidance to unlock.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Nac wrote:
> Hi
>
> I couldn't find how to solve Form of Mist vs Cats Guidance so I ask on broader terms: What happens on block resolution of a "continue as unblocked" action. Does window still exists?
>
See www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/82396-queued-combats?start=0

You can play Cats' Guidance once all combats are over.
So if A is blocked by B and plays Form of Mist to continue, B can play Cats' Guidance after combat to unlock (and perhaps try to block again).
